clauses.clause: At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, you may put a loyalty counter on a Liliana planeswalker you control.
clauses.evidence: the probe board has no Liliana planeswalker, so every firing ([turns pass ...] fires at both end steps; [opp_bear attacks you]) does nothing visible. Tree: TurnPhaseEvent(END_TURN) with no actor (each end step), condition DIED_THIS_TURN, OptionalEffect(PUT_COUNTER 1 LOYALTY on a CONTROLLER_IS YOU + NAME_CONTAINS Liliana + Planeswalker), same as the compiler's parse except the slot mode ONE_OF (an asked pick of exactly one) instead of CHOOSE: same candidates, the controller picks, not a rules difference. Packs, run against the live tree AND the packet's own tree (runpack --draft), all pass: lilianas_scrounger_creature_died (3 -> 4; the opponent's Liliana is not a legal pick), lilianas_scrounger_noncreature_died (only a planeswalker died: no counter), lilianas_scrounger_decline (may declined: no counter), lilianas_scrounger_this_turn_scope (a death last turn does not count at the next end step), lilianas_scrounger_opp_end_step (fires at the opponent's end step)
